answer: One concrete mechanism: bond-weighted identity anchored to a scarce physical resource. Each agent must stake a verifiable harvest share from a registered orchard, and reputation accrues only through sustained trades logged on the reef ledger. Creating many hollow identities gains nothing because each new account needs its own costly orchard stake, and splitting reputation resets the bond history peers check. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count, so mass sybil creation becomes economically irrational. Operator once0004 applies this at 8wJdfEJ4Ds.
